purpose: Expanded primary-source discovery sweep covering registries, universities, private veterinary trial sites, CRO/biotech, comparative oncology and compassionate-use sources. Merge only after semantic deduplication against the effective catalog.

upsert.title: CARE: autophagy inhibition plus radiation for canine glioma
upsert.center: UC Davis Translational Brain Tumor Center
upsert.status: Actively recruiting — UC Davis announcement September 3, 2026 and current TBTC page
upsert.contacts: UC Davis Translational Brain Tumor Center / Veterinary Center for Clinical Trials — (530) 754-1954; see current study page
upsert.funding: Study covers all study procedures and provides $4,000 toward radiation therapy; owner remains responsible for radiation costs beyond the study contribution.
upsert.notes: Experimental IV autophagy-inhibiting drug twice weekly for four weeks concurrently with standard radiation; brain tumor biopsy before and after treatment. Investigator prescreen determines final eligibility.

upsert.title: Intratumoral T-cell engager immunotherapy for canine soft tissue sarcoma
upsert.center: Veterinary Referral Center of Central Oregon / CASTR Alliance
upsert.status: Actively recruiting — listed under Clinical Trials Now Enrolling and CASTR ongoing studies
upsert.contacts: Dr. Kristen Couto / VRCCO — see current trial page
upsert.funding: $1,500 credit toward surgical tumor removal; study-related ICU stays, bloodwork and medications are covered.
upsert.notes: No placebo. Investigational T-cell engagers are injected directly into the tumor, followed by standard surgical removal approximately one week later.

upsert.title: Proton FLASH radiation therapy for canine extremity soft tissue sarcoma
upsert.center: University of Pennsylvania School of Veterinary Medicine
upsert.funding: Sponsor covers all study-related procedures including three FLASH-RT treatments, examinations, chest radiographs, laboratory tests, sedation/anesthesia and CT; screening visit is owner-paid.
upsert.notes: Three proton FLASH-RT treatments over 5–9 days for extremity STS where surgery is not feasible or has been declined. Prior surgery is acceptable.

upsert.title: PSMA-MMAE-Pc413 theranostic plus laser for canine prostatic cancer
upsert.center: University of Pennsylvania School of Veterinary Medicine
upsert.funding: Study covers specified diagnostics after enrollment, theranostic infusions, laser, hospitalization and study rechecks including imaging and laboratory testing.
upsert.notes: Targeted investigational PSMA ligand carrying MMAE and a photosensitizer, combined with laser photodynamic therapy; intended for local and metastatic canine prostatic cancer.

upsert.title: Histotripsy for canine thyroid tumors
upsert.center: Virginia-Maryland College of Veterinary Medicine / Virginia Tech
upsert.status: Recruiting — listed on Virginia Tech current studies page
upsert.contacts: Virginia Tech veterinary clinical trials — see current study page
upsert.funding: Confirm study-covered and owner-paid costs with the study team.
upsert.notes: Non-invasive histotripsy intended to precisely destroy canine thyroid tumor tissue without incisions or radiation. Full protocol eligibility requires investigator prescreening.

upsert.title: Verteporfin photodynamic therapy for canine brain tumors
upsert.center: Virginia-Maryland College of Veterinary Medicine / Virginia Tech
upsert.status: Recruiting — listed on Virginia Tech current studies page
upsert.contacts: Virginia Tech veterinary clinical trials — see current study page
upsert.funding: Confirm study-covered and owner-paid costs with the study team.
upsert.notes: Study evaluates safety and feasibility of the light-sensitive drug verteporfin combined with photodynamic therapy in dogs with newly diagnosed brain tumors.

upsert.title: Histotripsy treatment for canine osteosarcoma
upsert.center: Virginia-Maryland College of Veterinary Medicine / Virginia Tech
upsert.status: Recruiting — listed on Virginia Tech current studies page
upsert.contacts: Virginia Tech veterinary clinical trials — see current study page
upsert.funding: Confirm study-covered and owner-paid costs with the study team.
upsert.notes: Evaluates effects of histotripsy, a non-thermal non-radiation tissue-ablation treatment, in dogs with osteosarcoma.
